title: 第59章 黎志义撂了
content_zh:
第59章 黎志义撂了-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

上一章

存书签

下一章

黎志义用尽身上最后那点力气，脑袋像捣蒜一样拼命往下点。

顾承安满意了。

他伸手开始取针，一根一根地拔出来，手法比扎进去的时候温柔了不少。每拔出一根，黎志义的身体就会明显一抖，但比起之前那种要死要活的反应，这点动静已经算是“温和”了。

一一取出银针，码回针包里卷好，悄然收入系统空间。

然后手一晃，一把D80出现在他手上，给他割开扎带，手再一晃收起。

“起来吧。”顾承安拍拍手，站直身子，“咱们换个地方谈，这里的空气质量属实不太适合深入交流了。”

顾承安像是想到了什么，补充了一句：“你看你，现在已经治好了，应该不会再犯病了吧？不会到处乱伸腿、乱伸手了吧？”

黎志义拼了命地摇头，沙哑着嗓子回道：“不会，不会。”

仿佛怕回慢了一秒，就又要被扎针。

“好。”顾承安说，“现在你自己慢慢起来，先到你卧室去洗个澡，换身干净衣服。这一身的味儿，别说你了，我闻着都上头。

洗完了咱们坐下来好好聊聊，算算这次给你治病的好处。”

说完这句话，他也不看黎志义的反应。

右手从后腰摸出格洛克20。

左手按住弹匣释放钮，弹匣滑出，在手掌里翻了个面。

他把弹匣插回去，左手握住套筒往后一拉。

“咔嚓。”

套筒复进，子弹上膛。

那声金属碰撞在安静的影音室里异常清脆，像是有人在黎志义的心脏旁边敲了一下钟。

顾承安把枪口朝下，随手垂在腿侧，看了黎志义一眼。

“你是聪明人。”他说，语气和刚才聊天一样随意，“如果我发现你这个病没治好，走到一半又犯了——”

他晃了晃手里的枪。

“我保证在你犯病之前，能把你治得服服帖帖的。”

黎志义的喉结不由自主的上下滚了一下。

他两只手被扎带松开之后，撑着椅子扶手往上使劲，双腿一软，整个人直接从椅子上滑下去，膝盖重重磕在地板上。

他试着站起来，大腿抖得跟筛子似的，根本使不上力。

又试了一次。

还是不行。

黎志义偷偷瞟了顾承安一眼——后者面无表情，枪口稳稳指着他的方向，眼神漠然。

Li Zhiyi used up the last bit of strength in his body and pressed his head down like a pound of garlic.

Gu Chengan was satisfied.

He reached out and started to take out the needles, pulling them out one by one, his technique was much gentler than when he inserted it.Every time he pulled out one, Li Zhiyi's body would tremble obviously, but compared to the life-threatening reaction before, this movement was considered "mild".

Take out the silver needles one by one, put them back into the needle bag, roll them up, and put them quietly into the system space.

Then with a flick of his hand, a D80 appeared in his hand, cut the tie for him, and then put his hand away again.

"Get up." Gu Chengan clapped his hands and stood up straight, "Let's talk somewhere else. The air quality here is really not suitable for in-depth communication."

Gu Chengan seemed to have thought of something and added: "Look, you are cured now. You shouldn't get sick again, right? You won't stretch your legs or reach out everywhere, right?"

Li Zhiyi shook his head desperately and replied in a hoarse voice: "No, no."

It was as if he was afraid that if he was delayed for a second, he would be stabbed again.

"Okay." Gu Chengan said, "Now get up slowly and go to your bedroom to take a shower and change into clean clothes. The smell of this body, let alone you, makes me sick.

After washing, let's sit down and have a good chat, and calculate the benefits of treating you this time."

After saying this, he didn't look at Li Zhiyi's reaction.

With his right hand, he took out the Glock 20 from the lower back.

Pressing the magazine release button with his left hand, the magazine slid out and turned over in the palm of his hand.

He inserted the magazine back in, held the slide with his left hand and pulled back.

"Click."

The slide is retracted and the bullet is loaded.

The sound of metal clashing was extremely clear in the quiet audio-visual room, as if someone was ringing a bell next to Li Zhiyi's heart.

Gu Chengan pointed the muzzle of the gun down, casually hanging it by his leg, and glanced at Li Zhiyi.

"You are a smart person." He said, his tone was as casual as the previous conversation, "If I find out that your disease has not been cured, and you commit another crime halfway through -"

He shook the gun in his hand.

"I promise that I can treat you well before you get sick."

Li Zhiyi's Adam's apple rolled up and down involuntarily.

After his hands were released from the tie, he pushed up on the armrests of the chair. His legs softened and he slid directly from the chair, hitting his knees heavily on the floor.

He tried to stand up, but his thighs were shaking like sieves and he couldn't use any strength at all.

Tried again.

Still not working.

Li Zhiyi glanced at Gu Chengan secretly - the latter had an expressionless face, the gun pointed steadily in his direction, and his eyes were indifferent.
